verdict.rationale: Cognee is open-source and can run entirely locally/self-hosted with no account required, meaning data never has to leave the user's own infrastructure — this inherently prevents third-party use for model training. However, there is no explicit privacy/data-training policy statement (e.g., 'we do not train on your data') for users of Cognee Cloud or the hosted platform, so the guarantee is only implicit and tied to the self-hosted deployment path. Missing for 10: an explicit no-training data-use policy, terms-of-service language addressing model training, and clarity on Cognee Cloud's data handling.
